definitions.explanation: having a sharp incline; difficult to climb or traverse
forbidding or threatening in appearance or manner

examples.japanese: {険|けわ}しい{山道|やまみち}を{登|のぼ}る。
examples.english: To climb a steep mountain path.

examples.japanese: この{崖|がけ}は{非常|ひじょう}に{険|けわ}しい。
{頂上|ちょうじょう}への{道|みち}は{険|けわ}しく{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: The path to the summit is steep and dangerous.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{険|けわ}しい{表情|ひょうじょう}をしていた。
{状況|じょうきょう}は{険|けわ}しくなってきた。
examples.english: The situation has become more severe.

examples.japanese: {険|けわ}しい{顔|かお}で{見|み}られて{緊張|きんちょう}した。
examples.english: I got nervous when they looked at me with a harsh expression.

notes:
SENSE 1 - STEEP:
- Used for terrain, paths, mountains, cliffs
- {険|けわ}しい{山|やま} (steep mountain)
- {険|けわ}しい{道|みち} (steep path)

SENSE 2 - HARSH/STERN:
- Used for facial expressions, situations
- {険|けわ}しい{表情|ひょうじょう} (stern expression)
- {険|けわ}しい{顔|かお} (harsh face)
- {先行|せんこう}きが{険|けわ}しい (the outlook is grim)

RELATED WORDS:
- {急|きゅう} (steep, sudden)
- {厳|きび}しい (strict, severe)

KANJI NOTE:
{険|けん}しい uses the same kanji as {危険|きけん} (danger), reflecting the challenging nature of steep terrain.
